text:
Filip Forsberg has always been a shooter first, so 14 assists in 16 games stands out. The Hockey News had him on pace for career highs through October, and Yahoo Sports wrote that Shane Wright fit in fast beside him in his first game for Nashville.

Some of this will cool. The Predators have scored 7.3 more goals than their chances with Forsberg on, while their five-on-five shot attempt share with him is just 43.3% and their expected-goal share 48.5%. His 3.49 points per 60 is above the top of our range (3.31). His own finishing is normal, 5 goals on 5.2 expected, so it's the assists riding the luck.

He's 32 and the shot is still there (92nd percentile top speed on it). Last season he scored 40 goals in 82 games, and the plays-like list pairs him with volume shooters like Matt Boldy and Dylan Guenther. Our projection: 26 to 43 goals, 72 to 99 points. Watch the five-on-five share; it has to climb for the points to hold once the bounces even out.
headline: Forsberg is setting up, and the bounces help
